subject: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
definition: 直接移除生命，不算伤害
evidence: Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

context.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
context.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

subject: templar_assassin_refraction
definition: 直接移除生命，不算伤害
evidence: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。

context.description_en: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
notes_en: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
notes_zh: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。

shard_loc.en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard_loc.zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

subject: undying_decay
definition: 获得其他单位的技能
evidence: 力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。

context.description_en: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
context.description_zh: 不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
notes_en: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.
notes_zh: 窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。

definition: 获得其他单位的技能
evidence: Cannot steal item abilities.
无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。

context.description_en: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
context.description_zh: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
notes_en: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
scepter_loc.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。

shard_loc.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
shard_loc.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。

subject: muerta_pierce_the_veil
definition: 获得其他单位的技能
evidence: When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

context.description_en: Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
notes_zh: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。

subject: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
definition: 夺取目标的属性
evidence: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。

context.description_en: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
context.description_zh: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。

shard_loc.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
shard_loc.zh: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。

subject: silencer_brain_drain
definition: 夺取目标的属性
evidence: If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.
If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.

context.description_en: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.  If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.
context.description_zh: 沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近%permanent_int_steal_range%范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果，沉默术士都会永久窃取其%permanent_int_steal_amount%点智力。如果敌方英雄阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取%silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount%点智力。

subject: slark_essence_shift
definition: 夺取目标的属性
evidence: If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。

context.description_en: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
context.description_zh: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
notes_en: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.
notes_zh: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

subject: bane_brain_sap
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%.

context.description_en: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成%shard_radius%作用范围的技能。次级目标只有%shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%治疗效果。

subject: bane_fiends_grip
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.
魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每%fiend_grip_tick_interval%秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
scepter_loc.zh: 魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受%scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

subject: earthshaker_fissure
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

context.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
context.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

shard_loc.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard_loc.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

subject: nevermore_shadowraze1
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit.
每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
context.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

subject: nevermore_requiem
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend.
降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
context.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

subject: pudge_meat_hook
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.

context.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

subject: razor_storm_surge
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius.

notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard_loc.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. subject: venomancer_noxious_plague
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds.
冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。

context.description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
context.description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
notes_en: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

减少冷却时间。

context.description_en: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
notes_en: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
notes_zh: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。

notes_en: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。

subject: pugna_life_drain
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s.
冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

subject: life_stealer_infest
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.
提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。

context.description_en:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。

shard_loc.en: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

subject: chen_hand_of_god
definition: 缩短技能或物品的冷却
evidence: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds.
上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。

context.description_en: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
context.description_zh: 治疗地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。
notes_en: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
notes_zh: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

context.description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

scepter_loc.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。
